resources.string: Welcome. I\'m Nine, your personal assistant, running entirely on this device. Tap the orb and say something like \"set an alarm for 6 AM\", or simply chat with me.
Command mode · AI brain not enabled
Download Gemma 4 (2.6 GB for E2B or 3.7 GB for E4B, choose in Settings; once, Wi-Fi recommended). Then Nine can chat and answer questions without the internet.

The server requires a Hugging Face login. Open the model page in a browser, accept the license, create a \"Read\" token at huggingface.co/settings/tokens, paste it below, then retry. Or download the model file in a browser and use \"Import model file\".
Download failed (%1$s). Check your connection and retry.
Not enough storage (about 3 GB free needed).
The model file is incomplete. Please download again.
Delete this Gemma model? Nine returns to command mode (or internet mode if enabled).
Only needed if the download is refused for requiring a login. The token stays on this device.
Nine does not use a human voice. It talks in droid-style beeps, chirps and whistles generated on the phone, while the content of each answer still appears as text.
Make Nine your digital assistant so you can summon it by holding the side key (set in Settings > Advanced features > Side key > Press and hold > Wake digital assistant).
Your voice, commands, conversations and notes are processed and stored only on this device. The internet is used once, to download the Gemma model from Hugging Face.
No tasks yet. Type below, or tell Nine: \"add buy milk to my to-do list\".
Nine orb (follows theme): tap to talk
Use Gemini + Google Search when online

Open questions are answered by Gemini (Google) with web search, so Nine can handle weather, news, exchange rates and anything recent. Needs a free API key from Google AI Studio. When offline, Nine falls back to on-device Gemma. Phone commands (alarms, calendar, tasks, apps) are still processed on the device.
Your city (optional, for weather), e.g. Jakarta
Internet mode off · all answers come from offline Gemma.
Enter an API key to enable it.
On · no internet right now, using offline Gemma.
Gemma 4 E4B · 3.7 GB · smarter, a little slower

English phrases, separate several with commas, e.g. \"hey nine, okay nine\". Detection runs offline and keeps the microphone on (slightly more battery). To let Nine appear over other apps, make it the default digital assistant or grant the permission below.
Allow Nine to appear over other apps
The wake-phrase model is missing from this APK.
\"Automatic\" picks the calendar of the account you use most. Choose one manually if events don\'t show up in your calendar app.
● Recording %1$s · tap the orb to stop
Nine uses your approximate location for weather, nearby places and local time. It\'s only sent to Gemini when Internet mode is on, and never stored.
Nine orb (follows theme): tap to talk
Large Nine orb 4×4 (follows theme): tap to talk
Unlock to continue your Nine command
No alarms yet. Tap Add alarm, or tell Nine: \"set an alarm on weekdays at 6 AM\".
Nine alarms · turn on, off or delete them by voice

Nine alarms ring on time even when the phone sleeps, show on the lock screen, and can be controlled by voice (\"turn off the 6am alarm\", \"delete the gym alarm\"). Alarms made in the Clock app can\'t be changed by other apps.
Allow full screen when an alarm rings
Automatically remember what I tell you
Delete everything Nine remembers about you?

Nine remembers lasting things you tell it (name, likes, family, habits) and uses them in later conversations. Everything stays on this phone only. Say \"remember that …\" to save something right away, or \"forget …\" to remove it. This is memory, not retraining of the model.

Lets Nine switch Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, airplane mode and hotspot on or off through Quick Settings, play a chosen song in YouTube Music, and show a floating AssistiveTouch-style button. Nine only acts when you ask; screen content is not read beyond those tasks, stored, or sent to the internet.

Nine\'s accessibility service (optional) lets Nine switch Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, airplane mode and hotspot on or off, pick and play a song in YouTube Music, and show a floating button. Android 13+: if \"Nine\" is greyed out in the accessibility list, open App info, tap the ⋮ menu and choose \"Allow restricted settings\".

Lite edition: the floating button, automatic song playback and direct Wi-Fi/Bluetooth switching are only in the Full edition (Nine-Full.apk; Play Protect scanning must be switched off briefly while installing).
While the Nine screen is open, Nine listens to music through the microphone and its face moves with the beat, bass and tone. Audio is never recorded or stored.
White Nine orb: tap to talk
Large white Nine orb 4×4: tap to talk
